source.title: Full Interview: MJ Carpio, Move Minnesota
source.description: In this new series, I'll be sharing full (nearly) unedited interviews, so you can see every bit of the great conversations I have when creating videos for this channel. For this first video, I interviewed MJ Carpio, Campaign Manager with Move Minnesota. Move Minnesota was critical to the massive wins that came out of the most recent session of Minnesota state legislature, which I detailed in [this video](https://urbanists.video/w/1PJuZStu3T1Y6f3dkQ49ZT). **[Join MoveMN](https://www.movemn.org/take-action/)** **[Donate to help expand the channel](https://liberapay.com/HeartlandUrbanist/donate)** **[Find me on Mastodon](https://union.place/@mattcaff)**
